# Policymaker #863, iteration 0201 (trigger: every 3 iterations)

The Policymaker added one task-writing rule for the Shaper. The loop needs no other change now.

- Iterations 0199 and 0200 closed. Iteration 0200 is accepted and improved. `no_progress` is 0.
- The tool note from #854 worked. Benchmark sessions #856 and #860 are done and merged. Reviews #857 and #861 are done. No session stopped on the native-tool message.
- Step 4 of the positive-control thread (#763 f4) used two review rounds that found stale pins. First, #857 found finding 4 (old `score.py` and `challenges.json` pins). Then #861 found finding 1 (old `benchmark/preparation.json` pin).
- I measured the pin map. Of 62 `protected_inputs_sha256` entries in `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`, one does not match the file on disk: `benchmark/preparation.json` (pinned 99069d8d…, disk e304aff0…).
- Cause: the task verification checked only the named hashes. It did not check the full live pin map.
- Change: `execution/roles/orchestrator/SKILL.md`, section "Writing a task", has one new rule. When a task changes a pinned file, its `## Verification` checks every entry of each live pin map against the disk. Historical snapshots stay frozen.
- Expected gain: the next step-4 fix and its re-review close in one iteration. Later changes to pinned files need no extra stale-pin review round.
- Check: the next record has a pin task whose Verification checks the full map, and its review is CLEAR.
- `.session/orders.json` is `{"wake": false, "tasks": []}`. There is no Owner request and no change to params, routing or the evaluator.
- Limitation: reviewers #857 and #861 ran claude-sonnet-5-5. This is the same model family as the authors, so these reviews are not different-family reviews. The cause is not known.
- Benchmark readiness stays false. Product quality is not measured. There is no accepted Goal gate.

Details: `policy/working-memory.md`, section "Latest: Policymaker #863".

## Discoveries

- `python3 -B benchmark/scripts/check_real_project_0107.py` fails with "input-hash:benchmark/writing/README.md". It pins an old `input-pins.json` (d6a9914b…), so it is probably a frozen historical checker. I did not verify this (`benchmark/scripts/check_real_project_0107.py:35`).

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
